universal_proof: For each disjoint ordered partition, both compositions have the sign of the same concatenation permutation. This proves (31), (34), (36), and (37) in every rank over Z, hence by base change over any commutative ring. Equation (32) follows by pairing and exterior functoriality; its symbolic check verifies the conventions. Equation (33) is the same equality with an invertible map. Minors are the coefficients in the universal alternating expansion; the degree-4 polynomial certificate checks all row/column choices.
scope: Right contraction on the graded dual needs no finite-projectivity assumption. Uniqueness of a vector from its dual pairings does require separation by duals, and can fail for torsion modules.
